classic.lobby: Welcome to Agent Fault. Several hidden agendas, one remarkably optimistic artificial intelligence. This should go well.
classic.setup: Judge preparation. Assemble your assignment. Our artificial intelligence has already begun overestimating its abilities.
classic.submit: Agents, select your interference. Keep it secret. Plausible deniability is a feature.
classic.generate: Interference received. The A I is now attempting to recover from decisions it did not make.
classic.spotlight: The answers are in. Judge, select your favorite disaster.
classic.adjudicate: The secrets are out. Time to determine whether the A I truly went off the rails.
classic.review: The table has the final say. Democracy was a bold design choice.
classic.results: Round complete. Points have been awarded. Accountability remains optional.
classic.finished: Session complete. The system reports that everything went according to plan. This report is disputed.

cascade.lobby: Welcome to Agent Fault: Cascade. One conversation. Several agents. Absolutely no collective accountability.
cascade.setup: Judge programming. Prepare the scenario. The A I remains blissfully uninformed.
cascade.baseline: Awaiting the first answer. It is important to establish what normal looks like, while we still can.
cascade.lock_cards: Agents, lock your Interference cards. Consequences will be distributed shortly.
cascade.cascade: Interference deployed. The conversation continues, despite all available evidence.
cascade.handoff: A new agent inherits the problem. Please do not mistake this for a promotion.
cascade.judging: The human verdict. Judge, identify the most impressive malfunction.
cascade.challenge: A challenge has been filed. Apparently someone still believes in due process.
cascade.vote: The table votes. The algorithm is not eligible.
cascade.results: Round complete. The consequences have been tallied, and irresponsibility rewarded.
cascade.finished: Cascade concluded. The A I has requested reassignment.
